newsitem.title: USA: Data Documents forms technology alliance.
newsitem.headline: Data Documents forms technology alliance.

text.p: Data Documents Inc and Amgraf Inc of Kansas City, Mo., said they created a technology alliance.
Under the alliance, Amgraf will develop and supply a broad range of business forms-related software to be included in Data Documents' Odyssey Integrated Services program.
The alliance, when implemented, will facilitate an electronic proofing link between Data Documents' customers and its manufacturing facilities.
